page.layout: One page of text in one column; below it nothing. Marginal notes in the right margin, cut off at the scan edge and almost entirely illegible.

main_text.p: Subijcimus alteram: Si materia prima haberet corporeitatis formam propriè sic dictam, eamque in conceptu suo essentiali includeret, non esset simplex quiddam & primum in natura, sed compositum ex aliis principiis essentialibus: nempe materia & forma. Atqui falsum hoc, & processum in infinitum inducit. Ergo & illud falsum. Videantur plures rationes apud Suaretium tom.1.disp.13.Sect.3.num.11. & seqq. Esse etiam sententiam de corporeitatis forma doctrinæ Aristotelicæ planè contrariam multis ostendit Pererius lib.5.cap.15.[illegible, ~12 letters]

IV. Etsi verò inessentiali suo conceptu materia formam non includit, nunquam tamen sine forma in rerum natura existit, vel existere potest, propter ordinem naturæ & seriem causarum naturalium constantissimam. Perpetua enim & immota naturæ lex est: corruptio unius est generatio alterius: ut generatio unius est corruptio alterius; nempe per concomitantiam necessariam: Pererius libro 5. cap.13. Si tamen contingeret ut divina virtute materia omni forma privaretur, propterea in nihilum non redigeretur: Sed nihilominus, ut corpus incompletum, existeret, per generalem illum divinæ potentiæ concursum, quo omnia sustinentur & conservantur.
main_text.head: IX.
main_text.p: Hactenus prima materiæ notio: Secunda est, quâ materia, tanquam principium essentiale corporis naturalis consideratur. Estque consideratio hæc tota respectiva ad corpus

page.notes: The right margin is cut off by the scan edge; only fragments are visible (e.g. "corpus natur...", "Hinc", "politum", "efficien..."), so these notes are unreadable and given as one placeholder. The reading of the Pererius citation "cap.15" and the "13" in "disp.13" is uncertain (old-style numerals); the printed form may be 1ʒ/1ʃ. "proptereaiin" appears to be a printing error for "propterea in" and is left as printed. The "IX." line was set as a heading-like numeral in the printed text; it is a bare number, so it is treated here as a head and may be a paragraph number. The page ends mid-sentence with "corpus" on the last line, which continues on the next page.
